collection.name: snowGuards
collection.doc: 🛡️ Snow guard on a roof (EN 1991-1-3, 6.3 and 5.3.8): the roof it protects, the slope length behind it and the line force the design assumes against F_s = s b sin α.

fields.name: roof_id
fields.doc: 🏠 Id of the roof (roofs[]) whose snow the guard retains.

fields.name: slope_length
fields.doc: ↔️ Length b [m] of the roof slope behind the guard measured in plan.

fields.name: assumed_force
fields.doc: 🏋️ Line force [N/m] along the guard the design assumes.
